spec_notes: Telemetry Trench item catalog. Loaded by combat_engine.js at runtime. Item IDs are stable identifiers — never rename, only deprecate. Effect.type values are interpreted by combat_engine.js handlers; adding a new type requires an engine update.

items.name: Matrix Bolt
items.blurb: Standard-issue lane crackle. Fires once on the tick it's placed. Smooth scaling.

items.name: Drift Lance
items.blurb: Fires every other tick from placement. Won't spin up without breathing room.

items.name: Capacitor Mine
items.blurb: Detonates on tick 8. Needs four empty ticks behind to arm. Past that, charge stacks indefinitely. Glass cannon.

items.name: Void Battery
items.blurb: Fires on placement tick and again on tick 8. Two bites, modest ceiling.

items.name: Shroud Plate
items.blurb: Pre-combat: adds integrity to this lane. Charges expand the upper bound of the bonus roll.

items.name: Reflector Coil
items.blurb: Reflects incoming lane damage as a percentage. Needs spin-up. Full charge mirrors hardest.

items.name: Static Cage
items.blurb: Suppresses the enemy lane's first firing item. Binary — needs the warmup, no overcharge bonus.

items.name: Aegis Loop
items.blurb: Prevents this lane from collapsing once per round. Expensive, charge-hungry, ironclad.

items.name: Drift Tap
items.blurb: Adds +10% damage per charge to every other item on this lane. Synergy piece, no direct damage.

items.name: Phase Step
items.blurb: Items on this lane don't appear in your ghost layout when you die. Burn a slot to hide your tech.

items.name: Cascade
items.blurb: Copies this lane's damage to adjacent lanes. Half at min charge, full at max.

items.name: Keyword Forge
items.blurb: On tick 4, adds (drift_score × 10) damage to this lane. Converts spicy queries into direct hurt.

items.name: Drain Pole
items.blurb: Consumes the item one tick ahead (it doesn't fire) and doubles your own effective charges. Cannibal.

items.name: Echo Capacitor
items.blurb: Empty ticks behind on this lane count 2× toward charge for other items. Each charge past 3 adds +0.5× more.

items.name: Inversion Plate
items.blurb: Empty ticks ahead on this lane also count toward charge for other items. Front-load builds.

items.name: Sink
items.blurb: Doesn't fire. Enemy items in the same tick column lose 1 charge. Anti-overclock tech.
